testCase.name: [本地] S03 UAT journey as written: Hospital on 2 real consecutive days, Nursing Home visits on different days, timeline read as a trend view

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S03 「照 UAT 原文走一遍：医院用真实的连续 2 天，养老院在不同的日子就诊，把时间线当趋势视图来读」 UAT journey as written: Hospital on 2 real consecutive days, Nursing Home visits on different days, timeline read as a trend view

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated.（UAT TC-11；TFA-92589 AC 3）
  • U2 A day the patient was not seen is legitimately absent: no entry and no filler line for it.（UAT TC-11；TFA-92589 description 2）
  • U3 Hospital: the timeline shows yesterday and today only, per the retention rules.（UAT TC-11；UAT 3.6；TFA-92589 AC 4）
  • U4 Nursing Home: entries are keyed by visit number and labelled 'Visit N – date'.（UAT TC-11；TFA-92589 AC 5）
  • U8 Run in both modes for one patient each: Hospital across 2 consecutive days, Nursing Home across 3+ visits.（UAT TC-11；UAT 3.3）
  • T2 A new timeline entry is created automatically on every completed note, generated from that day's finished note.（TFA-92589 AC 2；TFA-92589 description 1）
  • T4 The timeline is readable as a quick trend view across the stay.（TFA-92589 AC 8；UAT TC-11）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Local stack only, kept running across the 3 days, with live AI (never the store / TestFlight build, never dev): one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident on an @roundai.test account

When Hospital: complete a note on day 1 and on day 2, and view the chart again on day 3. Nursing Home: complete visits on three different days with one day skipped, then review the timeline

Then Hospital day 2 shows the day 1 and day 2 entries; on day 3 only day 2 and day 3 (day 1 is off the cards). Nursing Home shows Visit 1–3, each with its own date, the skipped day absent, no duplicates. The tester then reads the timeline instead of the notes and records whether the trend of the stay is clear

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：The tester compares the timeline with the list of completed visits and their dates; every failure quoted. Q3 decides the day 3 edge. T4 (folded in from the former S24): the entries are recorded and a person rates them as a trend view; there is no written oracle (Q8), so that part has no verdict

在哪跑：本地 manual（时间 lane，脚本代人做）；测试方法 TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S03 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-11.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane manual。

测试方法：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；辅助：EXPLORATORY · 探索测试 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：manual。

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S03

UAT journey as written: Hospital on 2 real consecutive days, Nursing Home visits on different days, timeline read as a trend view

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

本地新 lane manual：manual/results.json 里 status passed-partial → 通过（部分通过（判过的格子都通过，有一部分没跑 / 是模拟的））。

怎么测（manual/plan.json，automatable: partly）：chromium spec, live AI (5 pre-round Save Notes). Every course entry is written by the app's own pre-round Save Note (usePreRoundProcess / useSnfPreRoundProcess) with the browser clock (page.clock) on that day; the server's time:now answer is withheld at the Convex socket so the device clock stands (src/data/time.ts: 'A failed ask changes nothing'), the server clock is never moved. Hospital: Save Note on day 1 (D-2) and day 2 (D-1), Course Timeline read on day 2 and on day 3 (D0). Nursing Home: Save Notes on D-3, D-1 and D0 (D-2 skipped), Visit Timeline read after visit 3. Judged: one entry per day/visit with its own date, order, no duplicates, the skipped day absent, day 1 off the Hospital cards on day 3 (Q3-independent: 48 h old and two calendar days back). Recorded: T4 trend rating (Q8, a person rates the saved cards; 5-minute checklist), the day-1 line still in the ledger (Q2/T5). Not run: the Generate-completed entries (forbidden locally; dev lane). — The date/count/order/skipped-day cells are deterministic and run on the app's own Save Note path. T4 'is the timeline a readable trend view' has no written oracle (Q8), so a person rates it (record-only). Entries made from a finished note need Generate, which is forbidden on the local stack (dev lane); here the entries are the pre-round lines (Q12).

Ambulating 10 feet with walker, pain controlled at.

跑的时候（runNote）：Intermittent, not counted: in 4 Save Notes today (TC-20/S17 NH during the 14:4x overload; TC-21/S17 Hospital at 16:55; TC-11/S03 NH at 16:59 and 17:02 JST) the text was saved but the structured summary never arrived and no error was set within 90 s (preRoundProcessing stuck true, or no notesProcessedAt and no preRoundError); the retries were clean. No aiCallLog row was captured for those attempts, so the cause (model latency vs app) is open; worth watching on dev. Observation, not judged: every entry the Save Note writes ends in a doubled full stop ('…oxygenation.. ⏳ Encounter pending.', '…Continue PT/OT..'): the writers append '.' to a model entry that already ends in one (usePreRoundProcess / useSnfPreRoundProcess).

人工清单（manualChecklist）：

  • 【TC-11/S03 只剩一步：给时间线的“趋势是否清楚”打分（T4，Q8 没有书面标准，只记录不判 Pass/Fail；约 5 分钟，不用登录）】
  • 日期/条数/跳过的那天/不重复这些格子已经自动判了（cells-hospital.json、cells-nursing-home.json）。
  • 1. 打开 evidence/TC-11-S03/hospital-day2-pre-round.png 和 hospital-day3-pre-round.png，只看 Hospital Course → Course Timeline 的卡片，不看笔记。
  • 2. 打开 evidence/TC-11-S03/nursing-home-after-visit3-pre-round.png，只看 Visit Timeline 的三张卡。
  • 3. 各回答一句：这次住院/入住的走势清不清楚？（是/否 + 一句理由），写进 results.json 这条的 personRating。
  • 注意：本地这些卡片是 pre-round Save Note 写的那一行（Generate 本地禁用，Q12：没有完成笔记的 pre-round 行算不算条目还没定）；用 Generate 完成笔记后的卡片要在 dev 上跑。

证据：附了 7 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The given says local stack only, never dev, and doing it in one sitting needs the aging helper and a server-clock control, both through the local admin key; dev has neither.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
